#!/usr/bin/env bash
# R1264aa/ab: valid lines the d3ef4824 mask refused: a bare { in ${…}, a case word that is $(…), and $(( in ${…}.
x="${y//{/}"
echo "$x"
x=${y//{/}
raw=x
raw=${raw//{/}
open="${1:-{}"
echo "$open"
os="$(
  case $(uname -s) in
    Darwin) echo mac ;;
    *) echo "unsupported, can't continue" >&2 ;;
  esac
)"
echo "$os"
s=abcdef; i=1
echo "${s:$((i<<1)):2}"
echo done
